role: Practitioner who cannot read everything and does not want to. Wants the fewest items worth knowing and a reason to care about each one.
goals: Hold an informed conversation about what shipped, on five minutes a day
Understand the tradeoff behind a technique, not just its name
Turn reading into working code rather than a longer reading list
_seamNote: Single user today. Every data record carries user_id so going multi-tenant is a data change, not a rewrite. Agents take (profile, data) -> output; no personal facts are hardcoded in prompts.
_cadenceNote: Weekly by decision, not by default. A nightly predecessor ran for weeks and worked as designed; it was retired because a daily brief produces a queue, and a queue asks for a reaction each time it grows. Ingestion runs continuously — it is deterministic and nearly free. Judgement runs weekly, because judgement is what costs money.
